answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by tying voting and emission weight to a delayed, slashed bond rather than a free signup. Each new identity locks stake that only reaches its zenith after several epochs of unique, non-reusable work. Established non-kin peers attest those traces the way a lotus unfolds, one independent grade at a time; copied or farmed answers score zero and forfeit the bond. Until quorum forms, the stake sits in a harbor escrow, so mass-registered shells cannot convert into power.
